sentences.en: In the morning, we all walked to the hill.
Silver tied me with a rope and held it in his hand.
We reached the place marked on the map.
We found a big hole, and it was empty.
The sailors stood silent, and then they were furious.

sentences.ar: وقتها إجا رصاص من بين الشجر.
sentences.en: Then shots came from among the trees.
It was the doctor and Ben Gunn and our friends.

sentences.ar: بن غن كان لقى الكنز من زمان ونقله.
sentences.en: Ben Gunn had found the treasure long ago and moved it.
We went back to the ship with the gold.

sentences.ar: سيلفر هرب بالليل ومعه كيس مصاري.
sentences.en: Silver escaped at night with a bag of money.

sentences.ar: وأنا لحد اليوم بحلم بصوت الببغاء.
sentences.en: And to this day I dream of the parrot’s voice.
